objective: Calculate the six trigonometric ratios where defined and explain each undefined value using a zero denominator.

coverage.topic: Define the six functions from a terminal point
instruction: Define the six functions from a terminal point
examples: Read six functions from one point
coverage.retrieval: Write all six ratios from a fresh nonzero signed point and state the condition needed for each denominator.

coverage.topic: Distinguish tangent from cotangent
instruction: Distinguish tangent from cotangent
examples: Keep tangent and cotangent in order
coverage.retrieval: Explain tangent as vertical per horizontal and cotangent as horizontal per vertical, then test both on an axis.

coverage.topic: Pair each function with its reciprocal
instruction: Pair each function with its reciprocal
examples: Use cotangent when tangent is undefined
coverage.retrieval: Pair each reciprocal and explain why cotangent is zero on a vertical ray even though 1/tangent is undefined there.

coverage.topic: Normalize a non-unit point
instruction: Normalize a non-unit point
examples: Normalize a point with a radical
coverage.retrieval: Normalize a non-unit point with a radical coordinate and explain why positive scaling preserves all six ratios.

coverage.topic: Choose signs before calculating
instruction: Choose signs before calculating
coverage.retrieval: Predict every function's sign in each open quadrant before calculating any magnitude, and identify which signs pair together.

coverage.topic: Evaluate exact special and coterminal angles
instruction: Evaluate exact special and coterminal angles
coverage.retrieval: Reduce a new negative radian angle and a multiple-turn input, then compute all six exact values from a special point.

coverage.topic: Separate a zero numerator from a zero denominator
instruction: Separate a zero numerator from a zero denominator
examples: Separate a zero from an excluded value
coverage.retrieval: Give one zero quotient and one undefined quotient at the same angle, naming the numerator and denominator in each.

coverage.topic: Build the four axis rows
instruction: Build the four axis rows
coverage.retrieval: Rebuild all four axis rows from the ordered points and positive radius rather than reading a memorized output table.

coverage.topic: State domains with all excluded angles
instruction: State domains with all excluded angles
coverage.retrieval: Give the full excluded-angle families for four functions and filter them into a new interval with explicit endpoints.

coverage.topic: Check the ranges of the six functions
instruction: Check the ranges of the six functions
coverage.retrieval: State each function's range, justify the reciprocal gaps around zero, and construct a point with a large finite tangent.

coverage.topic: Distinguish reciprocals from inverse functions
instruction: Distinguish reciprocals from inverse functions
coverage.retrieval: Compare the reciprocal of a signed special value with its arcsine, arccosine or arctangent in a stated principal range.

coverage.topic: Read negative powers and calculator labels
instruction: Read negative powers and calculator labels
coverage.retrieval: Explain the difference between a negative power of an evaluated sine and an inverse-function key, including angle units.

coverage.topic: Recover all ratios from sine or cosine
instruction: Recover all ratios from sine or cosine
coverage.retrieval: Reconstruct all six ratios from a rational sine and then a radical cosine, choosing signs only after applying the quadrant.

coverage.topic: Recover a point from secant or cosecant
instruction: Recover a point from secant or cosecant
coverage.retrieval: Invert a supplied secant or cosecant, check its range and quadrant, and reconstruct every remaining exact function.

coverage.topic: Recover a direction from tangent or cotangent
instruction: Recover a direction from tangent or cotangent
coverage.retrieval: Choose a signed point from tangent or cotangent and normalize it; explain why the opposite point may have the same quotient.

coverage.topic: Check whether the given information is sufficient
instruction: Check whether the given information is sufficient
coverage.retrieval: Provide an ambiguous ratio and two contradictory givens, keeping valid alternatives and distinguishing sign from range failures.

coverage.topic: Derive the two additional squared identities
instruction: Derive the two additional squared identities
coverage.retrieval: Derive each additional squared identity by dividing the circle identity, and state the nonzero denominator it requires.

coverage.topic: Preserve domain restrictions when simplifying
instruction: Preserve domain restrictions when simplifying
coverage.retrieval: Simplify secant divided by tangent while retaining both original restrictions, then test the lost vertical-axis input.

coverage.topic: Explain even and odd behavior
instruction: Explain even and odd behavior
examples: Check an odd function at zero
coverage.retrieval: Use a reflected signed point to classify all six functions as even or odd, and explain why odd cotangent need not exist at zero.

coverage.topic: Explain why the periods differ
instruction: Explain why the periods differ
examples: Distinguish a period from the fundamental period
coverage.retrieval: Compare all six functions under half-turn and full-turn shifts, distinguishing a period from the smallest positive period.

coverage.topic: Test a claimed period with more than one point
instruction: Test a claimed period with more than one point
examples: Disprove a period inferred from zeros
coverage.retrieval: Disprove a period claim based on two equal zeros, then use an arbitrary point transformation to establish a valid period.

coverage.topic: Audit calculator output near an excluded angle
instruction: Audit calculator output near an excluded angle
coverage.retrieval: Contrast an exact vertical ray with a point whose horizontal coordinate is small but nonzero, and audit a rounded calculator result.

assessmentLimits: Every form requires all six ratios reconstructed from one given ratio and a quadrant, all six values at an axis with a zero-denominator explanation, a reciprocal compared with a principal inverse, and both parity and period reasoning. The four questions sample the broader practice coverage rather than certify every variant separately.
